## Goal
- Execute a 100-item certification order for the IVX Holdings platform, repairing all issues and issuing a 100% completion certificate with verified evidence.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Never print, expose, commit, rotate, replace, or regenerate secrets
- Never generate a new Android signing identity unless owner authorizes
- Never weaken, skip, or mark a hard gate optional to obtain a passing certificate
- GitHub main, Render production, `/health`, and `/version` must identify the same exact final commit
- A UUID/deployment ID/shortened label must never be presented as a Git commit SHA
- Certificate only from current exact-SHA evidence — no local tests, cached results, or simulated output
- Cannot push workflow file changes — GitHub token lacks `workflow` scope

## Progress
### Done
- Baseline verified: production running `24a1a56c07d63ade4e6979e9dcc8d2fc9417c8b0`, PR #142 merged at `3ab9e1c5ccd4a36f8702ca7e023a074813cfa342`
- Created branch `cert-main` tracking `github/main`
- Commit `b3863a34`: Fixed `backend/api/ivx-landing-go-live.ts` env diagnostic — `canUseSupabaseRestStore` now matches actual function (removed false anon-key rejection, added derived fallback key detection). Deployed to Render.
- Commit `b731a095`: Fixed `backend/api/ivx-landing-full-deploy.ts` `storeAwsCredentialsInDb` — now uses AES-256-GCM encryption matching owner variables store (was storing plaintext without IV/tag). Deployed to Render.
- Commit `ae4ecd7a`: Replaced 80x80 placeholder inline images with 1024x1024 originals, added `favicon.ico` to landing directory. Deployed to Render.
- Confirmed Android signing secrets are referenced in `android-production-signing.yml`, `ivx-enterprise-qa.yml`, `ivx-environment-secret-presence.yml` with `keytool` validation
- Confirmed landing page IS live at `https://ivxholding.com` (HTTP 200, 108475 bytes)
- Confirmed CSP already present in `index.html` line 36
- Confirmed www redirect already in `index.html` (JS redirect at top)
- Confirmed favicon links exist in `index.html` lines 43-47
- Confirmed analytics JS has PII sanitization and tracking functions
- Confirmed deal minimum investment code handles `minInvestment`/`min_investment`/`minimum_investment` fields

### In Progress
- Adding missing trpc routes to `backend/hono.ts`: `/api/trpc/waitlist.join` (POST) and `/api/trpc/landing.getDeals` (GET) — only `/api/trpc/waitlist.getStats` exists currently
- Phase 1 AWS credential binding — 15 encrypted rows exist in Supabase `ivx_owner_variables` table but cannot be decrypted on Render (encryption key not bound there)

### Blocked

All decryption candidate attempts failed. Sync workflow `ivx-sync-ai-render-from-owner-store.yml` has bug (line 85: `encryptionSecret` undefined, should be `encryptionSecrets[0]`) but cannot be fixed — GitHub token lacks `workflow` scope for pushing workflow changes. No env vars available in sandbox (all private env vars show len=0). Landing deploy returns `ok: False, missingEnv: ['AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID', 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY']`.
- **GitHub API access**: All tokens empty (GITHUB_TOKEN, RORK_PUBLIC_GITHUB_TOKEN, IVX_OWNER_TOKEN all len=0). Cannot verify secrets are actually set, list workflow runs, or trigger workflows.

## Key Decisions
- Used Supabase REST API (fetch) instead of supabase-js client in `storeAwsCredentialsInDb` to match owner variables store pattern
- Attempted workflow fix via direct push but reverted when GitHub rejected due to missing `workflow` scope on token
- Focused on backend code fixes that can be pushed without workflow scope

1. Add `/api/trpc/waitlist.join` (POST) and `/api/trpc/landing.getDeals` (GET) routes to `backend/hono.ts` before the `app.notFound` handler at line 6395
2. Add skip-to-main-content link and `<main id="main-content">` wrapper to `index.html`
3. Add stable deal slugs to deal rendering in `ivx-app.js`
4. Inject real Git commit SHA into `ivx-config.json` build metadata
5. Ensure S3/CloudFront 404 handling returns real 404 instead of SPA HTML
6. Run local CI checks: TypeScript, lint, tests, secret scan
7. Push all fixes, wait for Render deploy, verify SHA parity
8. Test production endpoints: deals, support chat, analytics events, health, version

- Supabase URL: `https://kvclcdjmjghndxsngfzb.supabase.co`, anon key length 219

name: Landing S3 Production Deploy

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
